scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const dir='tests';const args=process.argv.slice(1);const files=args.length?args:(fs.existsSync(dir)?fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.test.js')).map((file)=>path.join(dir,file)):[]);if(!files.length){console.log('No test files found; skipping node --test');process.exit(0);}const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',...files],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(result.status);"
